name: cityscroll-worker
description: Thin serverless backend for CityScroll: NL→query (Claude Haiku), a Checkbook NYC proxy, and a scheduled alert digest. Deployed as a single Cloudflare Worker.

scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy --var GIT_COMMIT_SHA:$(git rev-parse HEAD) --var WRANGLER_ENV:production
scripts.cf:kv: wrangler kv namespace create NL_METER && wrangler kv namespace create ALERT_STATE
